# MsHorace Tutoring

> Expert 1-on-1 math tutoring for middle and high school students (grades 6–9) specializing in Pre-Algebra and Algebra 1. Founded and led by Stenita Horace, an educator with 6+ years of experience and 900+ students helped. All sessions are live and virtual via Zoom.

## About

MsHorace Tutoring is a virtual math tutoring service based in White Plains, Maryland (Charles County) serving students in the DC Metro area — including Maryland (Prince George's County, Charles County, St. Mary's County), Northern Virginia (Alexandria, Arlington, Fairfax, Woodbridge), and Washington DC — as well as students nationwide.

**Tutor:** Stenita Horace
**Subjects:** Pre-Algebra, Algebra 1
**Grade Levels:** 6th, 7th, 8th, 9th grade
**Format:** Live 1-on-1 Zoom sessions; small group classes (up to 4 students)
**Rating:** 4.9 stars · 47 reviews

## Services & Pricing

- **30-Minute Session** — $40 per session
- **60-Minute Session** — $75 per session (most popular)
- **Group Class (75 min)** — $25 per student (up to 4 students)

### Session Packages
- **First Grading Period Pack** — 4 sessions, $300 (payment plan: 2×$150)
- **8-Session Pack** — 8 sessions, $600 (payment plan: 2×$300)
- **Grade Rescue Pack** — 3 sessions, $195
- **Weekly Rhythm Monthly Pack** — 4 sessions/month, $260/mo
- **"Two Kids" Family Pack** — 8 sessions for 2 siblings, $490 (payment plan: 2×$245)
- **Group Class Semester Pass** — 6 group sessions, $150

### Digital Products
Practice packets, study guides, and exam prep PDFs for Pre-Algebra and Algebra 1 available for self-paced download starting at $7.
